paras: The Alpha-N Alpha-GP Carbon Front Spoiler is designed to fit the BMW M3 G80 Sedan and G81 Touring Wagon 2021+, and the BMW M4 G82 Coupe and G83 Convertible 2021+, and is available in Australia through iilumolab. Developed and manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance, a brand with deep roots in BMW motorsport, this carbon front spoiler delivers a refined motorsport-inspired upgrade for the front of the G8X platform.

Designed to complement the sharp factory styling of the G8X bumper, the Alpha-GP spoiler extends the lower edge of the bumper to add a more purposeful motorsport profile while improving airflow management at the front of the vehicle. The optimised airflow path under the front of the car contributes to better aerodynamic balance and increased stability at speed.
hl: Manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance
